edits.value_json: "on cycle with rst_n=0: out_valid=0, in_ready=0, output register content don't-care but held deterministic by flops, pending/pre-reset work discarded"
edits.reason: Align reset-time in_ready with interface/module semantics and suppress transfers during reset edge per reviewer finding.

edits.value_json: "EMPTY -> FULL on input transfer; FULL -> EMPTY on output transfer. Simultaneous dequeue/enqueue in FULL is architecturally forbidden; if FULL at cycle start, in_ready=0 for that cycle regardless of out_ready/in_valid, so next input can be accepted no earlier than the first cycle after FULL->EMPTY."
edits.reason: Remove ambiguity and make explicit that simultaneous replacement in FULL is not legal in this contract.
